title: 第91章 你，离我妹远点！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 原本只是灵光一闪，唐逸却已经心跳加速。直觉告诉他，这就是答案。整个京都，除了炎文帝，谁还有资格让暗京楼这么兴师动众？“我靠，一群阴沟里见不得光的老鼠，现在想要蚕食大象，这是疯了吧？”唐逸震惊了，但随之而来的是满腔的愤怒。暗京楼是什么样的存在，他已经有一个大概的了解，那是大炎最大的一个杀手组织，也是大炎最大的一个毒瘤。他们眼中没有善恶，没有是非，只要钱给得足够，什么活都接。人命在他们手中就像是猪狗一般，可以随意屠杀。二十年前的靖康耻，暗京楼就扮演了不可或缺的角色。当年，就是暗京楼和北狄勾结，沿途暗杀了大炎的诸多将领，导致大炎军心涣散，北狄大军才不费吹灰之力，就踏平了京都。那一战，上百万百姓因此丧命！原本大炎锦衣卫还能和暗京楼抗衡一二，但靖康耻让锦衣卫受到重创，从此也只能被暗京楼压着打。现在，暗京楼竟然还想卷土重来，真要让他们得手了，不知道又会死多少人。“妈的，这该不会又是北狄的奸计吧？”唐逸想到这些顿时头皮发麻，暗京楼这么大动静，应该是“北放北狄，东打动虞”的策略生效了。筹谋了多年的计划就这样简单被炎文帝瓦解了，让北狄恼羞成怒了，打算一不做二不休，直接花大代价让暗京楼出手，杀了炎文帝。推到这一步，唐逸下意识咽了咽口水，脊背都直冒冷汗。说实话，这时候他挺感激炎文帝的。如今整个朝堂都知道抵御北狄的计策，是小诗仙给皇帝出的计策，要不是炎文帝将有关他的身份信息严密掌控起来，恐怕现在他早就被北狄灭了立威了。毕竟宰了他，可以给炎文帝一个警告，还可以将炎文帝的脸按在地上摩擦。呼！唐逸站在办公桌前，双手撑着桌面深吸了一口气，想要将心中的所有情绪平复下来，然而却压不下那恐怖的危机感。妈的原本以为沈园诗会一鸣惊人，再加上锦衣卫的身份，在京都完全可以横着走。但现在看来，一旦小诗仙的身份暴露，等待他的将会是暗京楼，是北狄和东虞谍者无休止的暗杀。而以他现在的实力，干得过谁？“不行，不能这样被动挨打，得主动出击。”唐逸手缓缓攥成拳，眸中寒光凛冽：“而且，一出手还必须威震八方，让所有人忌惮，才能争取更多的时间发育。”“否则，别说发育，能不能见到第二天的太阳都两说。”唐逸手轻轻敲着桌案，一个大胆而疯狂的计划，开始在心中酝酿！“喂，你干嘛呢？发什么呆？”后脑勺被人敲了一下，唐逸扭头看去，萧棣吊儿郎当地站在旁边打量着他：“你没事吧你？进来就在这里发呆，脸色还冰冷得要杀人，怎么？女人被人抢了？”“不应该啊，你唐四少幻音坊一夜御三大花魁，已经成了京都传奇了啊！”唐逸嘴角微抽，那三个女人到底对外说了什么？他当晚明明逃走了好吧。老子的一世英名啊！“你，离我妹远点。”萧棣仰起头，睨着唐逸警告。好色之徒，休要害我妹。“放心，我和你妹现在还是纯洁的病患和医生的关系。”唐逸瞥了萧棣一眼，前提是，你能管住你妹妹不来招惹我。这时，唐逸才发现刚才人满为患的二处，现在只剩下他们两人了。“嗯？人都哪去了？”唐逸问道。萧棣指了指外面，道：“宫里来了圣旨，都外面接圣旨去了。”唐逸眼皮一跳，接圣旨？你能别说得那么风轻云淡吗？你是皇子问题不大，可我就是个锦衣卫百户，现在二处正愁找不到机会收拾我呢，到时候一个大不敬的罪名，可都够我喝一壶的。“别去了，现在锦衣卫的人都跪在院中听旨，你这时候过去才是大不敬。”萧棣双手枕着头，在唐逸的位置坐了下来。“等着吧，估计是宫里哪位又想搞事情了。”“咱们，又得开始上他的棋局了……”唐逸觉得萧棣说得对，这时候跑出去全场跪着了，就只有他一个人站着，的确更容易出事。看着萧棣对炎文帝满脸的不爽，他摸了摸鼻道：“你对陛下很了解？不如给我透露点，以后做事的时候，我心里好歹有个谱。”他对炎文帝并不了解，只知道他是个有雄才大略的帝王。可越是这种有雄才大略的帝王，手段往往更加的阴狠毒辣，万一有一天莫名其妙的惹怒了皇帝，被杀了祭天怎么办？“他？呵！”萧棣抬头看向唐逸，目光玩味道：“记住了，他就是个老阴批，从这老家伙嘴里说出来的话，一个字都不要信。”呃，这家伙对炎文帝意见这么大的吗？唐逸眯起了眼睛，有些好奇道：“所以，你爹对你做了什么？”“那个老东西，他竟然……”萧棣一巴掌拍在桌上站了起来，脸色那是一个愤懑，只是话没说完他又立即捂住嘴，瞪着唐逸道：“干嘛？和你有关系吗？别瞎打听！”这是有故事啊！唐逸心头莫名的开始有点八卦，干咳一声道：“怎么？你爹做了和唐玄宗一样的事？”萧棣一愣，疑惑看向唐逸：“唐玄宗？他是谁？他干了什么事？”唐逸一拍额头，忘记了，这个世界没有唐玄宗，自然就没有唐玄宗和杨贵妃的故事了。“没事，唐玄宗是一个开创了一个盛世的帝王。”唐逸随意敷衍了一句，萧棣盯着唐逸的脸打量起来，开创了一个盛世的帝王？老子怎么总觉得你刚才的话，好像想表达的不是这个意思吧？这时，门外传来喧嚣声。唐逸抬头，看到宁川正带着一处的人回来，只是此时宁川的脸色却极为精彩，有震惊有凝重，有错愕有惊喜……刚进门，宁川的目光便看了过来，瞅着他的目光极为诡异。这什么意思？难不成圣旨和我有关……唐逸走上前，拱手问道：“宁头，宫里来的是什么圣旨？”宁川抬手落在唐逸的肩膀上，道：“陛下将沈园诗会的保卫工作，交给了咱们锦衣卫一处……”“什么？！”宁川话没说完，萧棣已经蹿了起来，脸上震惊而错愕。“将保卫工作交给锦衣卫一处，他是疯了吗？”
content_en: It was just a flash of inspiration, but Tang Yi's heartbeat was already racing.His instinct told him that this was the answer.In the entire Kyoto, except Emperor Yanwen, who else is qualified to let Anjing Tower mobilize forces like this?"Damn it, a bunch of shady rats in the gutter want to eat an elephant now, are they crazy?" Tang Yi was shocked, but was followed by anger.He already had a rough idea of ​​what kind of existence Anjing Tower was. It was the largest killer organization in Dayan, and it was also the biggest cancer in Dayan.There is no good or evil, no right and wrong in their eyes. As long as they are given enough money, they will accept any job.Human lives are in their hands like pigs and dogs, they can be slaughtered at will.During the Jingkang disgrace twenty years ago, Anjing Tower played an indispensable role.Back then, An Jinglou colluded with Beidi and assassinated many generals of Dayan along the way, causing Dayan's army to become disheartened, and Beidi's army defeated Kyoto effortlessly.In that battle, millions of people died!Originally, Dayan Jinyiwei could still compete with Anjinglou, but Jingkang Shai caused Jinyiwei to be severely damaged, and from then on, he could only be suppressed and beaten by Anjinglou.Now, Anjing Tower actually wants to make a comeback. If they really want to succeed, I don't know how many people will die."Damn it, could this be Beidi's conspiracy again?" Tang Yi's scalp went numb when he thought of this. Such a big movement in the Anjing Tower should be that the strategy of "release Beidi in the north and impress Yu in the east" has taken effect.The plan that had been planned for many years was simply disintegrated by Emperor Yanwen, which made Beidi angry and angry. He planned to do nothing and pay a huge price to An Jinglou to kill Emperor Yanwen.Pushed to this step, Tang Yi swallowed subconsciously, and cold sweat broke out on his spine.To be honest, he was quite grateful to Emperor Yanwen at this time.Now the entire court knew that the strategy to resist Beidi was a strategy given to the emperor by Xiao Shixian. If Emperor Yanwen had not tightly controlled the information about his identity, I am afraid that he would have been destroyed by Beidi and established his power by now.After all, killing him would give Emperor Yanwen a warning, and he could also rub Emperor Yanwen's face on the ground.call!Tang Yi stood in front of his desk, put his hands on the table and took a deep breath, trying to calm down all the emotions in his heart, but he couldn't suppress the terrifying sense of crisis.Damn it, I originally thought that Shen Yuan's poetry would be a blockbuster, and coupled with his status as Jin Yiwei, he would be able to walk around in Kyoto.But now it seems that once Xiao Shixian's identity is exposed, what awaits him will be An Jing Tower and endless assassinations by spies from Beidi and Dongyu.And with his current strength, who can he defeat?"No, you can't be passively beaten like this. You have to take the initiative." Tang Yi slowly clenched his hands into fists, with a cold light in his eyes: "Moreover, the attack must be shocking and frightening to everyone, so that we can gain more time to develop." "Otherwise, let alone development, we have to decide whether we can see the sun the next day." Tang Yi tapped the table with his hand, and a bold and crazy plan began to brew in his heart!"Hey, what are you doing? Why are you in a daze?" Someone knocked him on the back of the head. Tang Yi turned around and saw Xiao Di standing aside and looking at him carelessly: "Are you okay? You came in and were in a daze here. Your face was so cold that you wanted to kill someone. What? The woman was robbed?" "That shouldn't be right. You, the fourth young master of Tang Dynasty, managed three oirans in one night at Huanyinfang, and you have become a legend in Kyoto!" Tang Yi's mouth twitched slightly. What did those three women say to the outside world?He obviously escaped that night, right?I am famous throughout my life!"You, stay away from my sister." Xiao Di raised his head and looked at Tang Yi to warn.Lechers, please don't harm my sister."Don't worry, your sister and I still have a pure relationship between patient and doctor." Tang Yi glanced at Xiao Di. The premise is that you can control your sister and not provoke me.At this time, Tang Yi realized that the two places that were crowded just now were now the only two of them."Huh? Where have everyone gone?" Tang Yi asked.Xiao Di pointed outside and said: "The imperial edict came from the palace, and everyone went outside to receive the edict." Tang Yi's eyelids twitched, receiving the edict?Can you stop speaking so lightly?It doesn't matter that you are the prince, but I am just a royal guard. Now the two offices are worried about finding a chance to deal with me. When the time comes, a charge of disrespect will be enough for me to drink a pot."Don't go. The people of Jinyiwei are kneeling in the courtyard to listen to orders. It would be disrespectful for you to come over at this time." Xiao Di rested his head on his hands and sat down at Tang Yi's seat."Wait a minute, someone in the palace is probably trying to stir up trouble again." "We have to start playing his chess game again..." Tang Yi felt that Xiao Di was right. At this time, he ran out and knelt in the audience. He was the only one standing, so it was indeed easier for something to happen.Seeing Xiao Di's dissatisfaction with Emperor Yanwen, he touched his nose and said, "Do you know His Majesty very well? Why don't you tell me a little bit, so that I can have a clue when doing things in the future." He didn't know much about Emperor Yanwen, he only knew that he was an emperor with great talents and great strategies.But the more talented and strategic an emperor is, the more sinister and sinister his methods are. What if one day he somehow angers the emperor and is killed to offer sacrifices to heaven?"He? Ha!" Xiao Di looked up at Tang Yi with a playful look: "Remember, he is an old yin critic. Don't believe a word that comes out of this old guy's mouth." Uh, does this guy have such a big opinion against Emperor Yanwen?Tang Yi narrowed his eyes and asked curiously: "So, what did your father do to you?" "That old guy, he actually..." Xiao Di slapped his hand on the table and stood up, with an angry look on his face. But before he finished speaking, he immediately covered his mouth and stared at Tang Yi: "What? Does it have anything to do with you? Don't pry!" There is a story!Tang Yi started to gossip inexplicably, and coughed dryly: "What? Your father did the same thing as Tang Xuanzong?" Xiao Di was stunned and looked at Tang Yi in confusion: "Tang Xuanzong? Who is he? What did he do?" Tang Yi slapped his forehead and forgot that without Tang Xuanzong in this world, naturally there would be no story about Tang Xuanzong and Yang Guifei."It's okay, Tang Xuanzong was an emperor who created a prosperous age." Tang Yi said casually. Xiao Di stared at Tang Yi's face and looked at him, "An emperor who created a prosperous age?"Why do I always feel that this is not what you meant by what you just said?At this time, there was a noise outside the door.Tang Yi looked up and saw Ning Chuan coming back with people from one place, but at this time Ning Chuan's face was extremely exciting, ranging from shock to solemnity, shock and surprise... He had just entered the door.
title_en: Chapter 91 You, stay away from my sister!
